selection.g_window_reason: G 12.0-16.5. Bright end: SPHEREx non-linearity starts near 11.5 AB (bands 1-4) and ~10 AB (bands 5-6); G=12 stars, even very red ones (G-K ~ 3, i.e. ~1-2 mag brighter than G in AB at 1-2 um), stay below the bands 1-4 onset only marginally, so NONLINEAR/OVERFLOW flags are also required clean in the 5x5 stamp. Faint end: G=16.5 still gives peak S/N >= 10 in the SWIR detectors for typical colours; fainter stars are mostly removed by the S/N cut anyway.
selection.isolation: no Gaia source with G < G_star+3.0 within 20.0 arcsec; none with G < 9.0 within 180.0 arcsec
